name: General-Purpose Native Compile Driver
sota: GCC driver model; LLVM standalone compilation
summary: JIT-safe native compile driver for arbitrary single-module .sio programs. Avoids module_loader.sio import (3900 lines JIT overhead). Supports -o flag and positional output arg. Typecheck intentionally skipped (saves ~30GB RSS). NOT_RUN: compile test requires 10+ min JIT overhead for finalize_elf64_for_machine (18.7GB RSS, cascading JIT compilation of ~200 ELF emitter helper functions).
fixes: Added use interop::contract::* import (transitive dep via io::file_write → contract types)
Added ulimit -s unlimited to gate script (IrModule ~11.7MB exceeds 12.5MB default stack)
blocker: JIT compilation of finalize_elf64_for_machine takes 10+ min at 18.7GB RSS — need native-compiled souc to break bootstrap cycle
